notes.rationale: Entschuldigung, said to a stranger before a question, is the apology formula, one word, so it is a Lexeme INTJ. The noun die Entschuldigung is another Lemma (Sie besteht auf einer Entschuldigung). Entschuldigung! before a stranger is asked something is Duden's 'Höflichkeitsformel' asking for forbearance, an apology for the intrusion, so it takes the 🙇 of the NOUN Entschuldigung. Knowledge (#884): Formula Role Apology, which holds for the one INTJ Reading, sorry and excuse me alike (Duden sense 3, DWDS sense 2); Initiation would fit only this use. Decided by agents under the user's delegation. Pardon is a synonym: OpenThesaurus lists it with Entschuldigung, and Pardon! covers sorry and excuse me alike. Tschuldigung is dropped as a clipped colloquial form of the same word (user, 2026-10-03, on the judges' split).
